root.name: クレーン・カンパニー

rows.ja: 分離・事業の買い取り
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 2023年4月に旧Crane Holdingsが2社に分かれた相手。分離・移行サービスなどの契約が続く
relations.text_en: Sister company from the April 2023 split of Crane Holdings; separation and transition services agreements continue

source.label: Crane NXT 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We and Crane Company entered into certain agreements in connection with the separation transaction, including a separation and distribution agreement, a transition services agreement

relations.text: Baker Hughesから計測機器事業(Druck・Panametricsなど)を約11.5億ドルで買い取った(2026年1月)
relations.text_en: Bought Baker Hughes' sensing business (Druck, Panametrics and more) for about $1.15 billion (January 2026)

source.label: Baker Hughes 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: During 2025, the Company entered into an agreement with Crane Company, a diversified manufacturer of engineered industrial products, to sell its Precision Sensors & Instrumentation ("PSI") business

companies.name: パーカー・ハネフィン

relations.text: Parker-Hannifinが10-Kで、航空機部品の主な競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Parker-Hannifin lists it first among primary competitors in aerospace products

source.label: Parker-Hannifin 10-K(2026年6月期)
source.quote: primary global competitors for these products include Crane Co., Eaton Corporation plc, Honeywell Aerospace Inc., Moog Inc., RTX Corporation, Safran S.A., Senior plc, Triumph Group, Inc., and Woodward, Inc.

relations.text: Flowserveが10-Kで、バルブ業界の大手競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Flowserve names it among the largest valve industry competitors

source.label: Flowserve 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of the largest valve industry competitors include Emerson Electric Co., Cameron International Corp. (a Schlumberger company), Baker Hughes, Rotork plc, Valmet, IMI Plc and Crane Co.

relations.text: Doverが10-Kで、燃料・クリーンエネルギー機器の競合として挙げる(Cryoflo)
relations.text_en: Dover names it a clean energy and fueling competitor (Cryoflo)

source.label: Dover 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Dixon Valve & Coupling Company, Crane Company (Cryoflo)

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
